description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, the Twins break down why the pre-listing meeting is one of the most important steps when selling your home.

Before you spend money on upgrades, repairs, or renovations, you need to know what actually adds value — and what doesn’t.

Not every improvement gives you a return.

A proper walkthrough helps identify what’s worth fixing, what can stay as-is, and how to position your home to sell without overspending.

If you're selling in Central Texas real estate, this step can save you time, money, and unnecessary stress.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, home selling tips, and real estate insights.
